title: Effective Memory Management and Sparse Aware Cache for Row-Wise Sparse CNNs
problem: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are used in several image processing tasks like image recognition and object localization
method: Convolutional neural networks for image processing often have many zero values; this approach exploits that sparsity by skipping zeros during computation instead of processing them. It organizes non-zero values in row-wise patterns that match how the processor's cache (fast memory attached to the processor) works, keeping related data together so the processor doesn't have to fetch from slower main memory as often. On resource-constrained hardware with limited cache, this reduces the bandwidth and power needed, making the network run faster.
key_novelty: Restructuring sparse CNN data to match row-wise cache patterns, so zero values don't waste precious cache space on resource-constrained hardware.
